description: Eight gate channels, each able to be muted or logically inverted

params.text: Holds that channel's output at 0V, shown by the lamp; press again to unmute
Turns that channel's gate over, so 0V becomes 10V and a high gate becomes 0V; a muted channel stays at 0V

inputs.text: The gate for channel 1, counted as high at 1V or more
The gate for that channel, counted as high at 1V or more; with no cable it takes the gate from the channel above

outputs.text: That channel's gate after muting and inversion, 10V or 0V
